en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding the man who buys the slave girl or marries her
without the right way, and he takes her for himself. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he does not fear the shame upon his children, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ’Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about the case of a man who buys a slave-girl or marries her
without proper wedlock and keeps her for his own self, he (the Imam) has said, ‘If he is not afraid of the stigma for his children, it is not unlawful.”’
